strategies.label: Created in scenario
strategies.hint: The submodels this run creates earlier in the timeline, addressed in order — the compiler works out which ones exist by the time this load starts, so the id is one the scenario really did POST. Falls back to what is already on the target if this load starts before any create has finished.

strategies.label: Existing on server
strategies.hint: Identifiers are paged off the target before the load starts and shared by every virtual user, so the run measures the corpus already on the server rather than what it just created.

maxIds.title: Fetch up to
maxIds.description: Paging follows the collection's cursor and stops here. The harvest runs once, before the first request.

onEmpty.title: If nothing is found
onEmpty.description: "warn" (default): every request using this binding is skipped, and the run continues — the same as any other empty identifier pool. "fail": the compile refuses outright, for a request whose whole point is measuring a corpus that must already exist.

strategies.label: Sequence
strategies.hint: A new identifier per request, following this format. <Num> is replaced by a counter shared by every "Sequence" create of this entity type across the whole scenario — one unbroken run of numbers regardless of which load or track creates it.

strategies.label: Existing
strategies.hint: Reuses an identifier this run already created — or, if none exist yet, one already on the target — instead of minting a new one.
strategies.warning: This deliberately creates duplicates: the POST targets an identifier that already exists.

maxIds.title: Fetch up to
maxIds.description: Only consulted when nothing this run has created yet exists to reuse.

strategies.label: Fixed
strategies.hint: A literal identifier, or a counter that increments per request.

format.title: Format
format.description: A printf-style %d or %06d placeholder is replaced with a counter that climbs each request.

strategies.label: Non-existing
strategies.hint: An identifier that is on neither the server nor the set this run created — synthesised after harvesting the server's ids to exclude. Exercises the 404 path.

maxIds.title: Check against up to
maxIds.description: How many server identifiers to page in for the exclusion check before the load starts.
